summary.name: AppCleaner
summary.one_liner: AppCleaner is a small macOS application that thoroughly uninstalls apps by finding and deleting their related files.
use_cases: Completely uninstall an unwanted Mac app
Remove leftover files after deleting an application
Free up hard drive space on a Mac
Clean up scattered support files from installed software
summary.what_it_does: AppCleaner is a small application for uninstalling unwanted apps thoroughly. The page explains that installing an app spreads many small files across the system, which AppCleaner finds and safely deletes. To use it, you drop an application onto the AppCleaner window. It then searches for related files, and you delete them by clicking the delete button. The page presents it as a freeware tool listed under cleanup and uninstall utilities.
notable: Drag-and-drop app onto window to find related files
Searches for and deletes scattered small files left by installed apps
caveats: Platform is inferred as macOS from the app context; the page text does not explicitly name the OS
